nodes.name: Order calculus for games
nodes.statement: For all games \(x,a,b,c\), reflexivity and transitivity are the assertions \[ xpreceq x, apreceq b\ wedge\ bpreceq c Longrightarrow apreceq c. \] Consequently \(sim\) is an equivalence relation, \(prec\) is transitive, and strict and weak inequalities compose in either order.

nodes.raw_latex:
\label{thm:game-order-calculus}
  
  
  For all games \(x,a,b,c\), reflexivity and transitivity are the assertions
  \[
    x\preceq x,
    \qquad
    a\preceq b\ \wedge\ b\preceq c
      \quad\Longrightarrow\quad a\preceq c.
  \]
  Consequently \(\sim\) is an equivalence relation, \(\prec\) is transitive, and strict
  and weak inequalities compose in either order.

Suppose reflexivity is known for all games of birthday smaller than \(bd(x)\), and unfold the comparison in Definition~.
